references.description: Ralph setup instructions and configuration guide

userStories.title: Add example feature
acceptanceCriteria: Feature works as expected
typecheck passes
tests pass
userStories.notes: Implementation: src/example.ts | Reference: https://example.com/docs | Dependencies: see package.json

userStories.title: Create an Openlap brand narrative developers can repeat
acceptanceCriteria: One concise positioning statement explains what request-lapping means
A tagline and 3 supporting message pillars are documented
Messaging includes when to use openlap in local development and CI
Voice guidelines include examples of preferred and discouraged phrasing
userStories.notes: Target outcome: teams can describe openlap consistently in docs, PRs, and onboarding materials.

userStories.title: Ship reusable team scripts and prompt templates for Openlap adoption
acceptanceCriteria: At least three npm script examples are documented (review, explain, fix)
Prompt template files include placeholders for repo-specific context
Examples cover interactive local use and non-interactive CI mode
Template naming is consistent and easy to discover
dependsOn: Create an Openlap brand narrative developers can repeat
userStories.notes: Focus on reducing adoption friction by making first-run setup obvious.

userStories.title: Define Openlap adoption metrics and feedback loop
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics include command usage, successful run rate, and repeat usage after one week
A lightweight feedback channel is documented for issues and UX friction
A weekly review process is defined to prioritize adoption improvements
Metrics can be reviewed without collecting sensitive prompt data
dependsOn: Ship reusable team scripts and prompt templates for Openlap adoption
userStories.notes: Use privacy-safe signals to measure whether branding and onboarding are increasing active usage.

userStories.title: Add GitHub Actions workflow for automated npm publish on version tags
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow triggers on v* tag push (e.g. git tag v0.2.0)
Full test and lint suite runs before publish step
Package is published to npm with --access public
GitHub Release is created with auto-generated changelog
userStories.notes: Currently published manually. Add .github/workflows/publish.yml. Requires NPM_TOKEN secret in repo settings.

userStories.title: Support project-level config file for CLI defaults
acceptanceCriteria: openlap reads .openlap.json or package.json#openlap from cwd on startup
Config supports all CLI flags as defaults (model, thinking-models, thinking-color, no-interactive)
CLI flags override config file values
Invalid config produces a clear error message
userStories.notes: Add loadConfigFile(cwd) in src/cli.ts before parseArgs(). Merge config into options. Teams standardize model + flags per project.

userStories.title: Support environment variables for CI-friendly configuration
acceptanceCriteria: OPENLAP_MODEL sets default model
OPENLAP_NO_INTERACTIVE disables interactive handoff
OPENLAP_CWD sets default working directory
OPENLAP_THINKING_MODELS sets thinking highlight models
Env vars are overridden by explicit CLI flags
Env vars are overridden by config file values
dependsOn: Support project-level config file for CLI defaults
userStories.notes: Modify parseArgs() in src/cli.ts to check env vars as fallback. Priority: CLI flags > config file > env vars > built-in defaults.

userStories.title: Improve error messages with contextual fix suggestions
acceptanceCriteria: ENOENT for opencode binary suggests install steps and links to opencode.ai
Empty clipboard with --copy suggests alternative input methods
Missing --file path shows the resolved path and suggests checking it
Permission errors on --cwd suggest the correct directory
userStories.notes: Small effort, high DX impact. Touch src/cli.ts (clipboard/stdin paths) and src/opencode.ts (ENOENT handler at line ~351).

userStories.title: Add edge case tests for event parsing and large output streaming
acceptanceCriteria: Test covers malformed JSON mixed with valid JSON in stream buffer
Test covers tool output exceeding 1MB through collapseToMax()
Test covers session ID extraction from various line positions
Test covers --show-tool-output with nested JSON in tool content
Test covers thinking block detection with unusual markdown formatting
userStories.notes: Current coverage in test/opencode.test.ts is solid but misses stream edge cases. Focus on buffer boundary and malformed input resilience.

userStories.title: Add shell completion scripts for bash, zsh, and fish
acceptanceCriteria: Bash completion script autocompletes all flags and example names
Zsh completion script autocompletes all flags and example names
Fish completion script autocompletes all flags and example names
openlap --completions <shell> outputs the appropriate script
Install instructions documented in README
userStories.notes: Add completions/ directory with static scripts or generate dynamically via --completions flag. Example names: explain, tests, refactor, docs, review.

userStories.title: Add structured output format options beyond raw and JSON events
acceptanceCriteria: --output-format json-final returns a single JSON object with all text and tool results
--output-format jsonl returns one JSON object per event line
Default streaming behavior is unchanged
Programmatic API in src/opencode.ts supports format parameter
userStories.notes: Enables integration with external analytics, logging pipelines, and structured CI output. Consider semver implications for API changes.
